identity.action: Thinking Machines Lab releases open-weight looped transformer Inkling 2 Mini
identity.dateBasis: Dated 2026-11-20 per official Thinking Machines Lab release post, model card, and Artificial Analysis report.
identity.deduplicationReason: Distinct model (Inkling 2 Mini with immediate open weights) separate from Inkling 2 Small (2026-11-05, Tinker-only with deferred weights).

classification.reason: Primary action is introducing a looped-MoE model architecture; secondary 'product' category is bound to immediate open-weight Hugging Face and Tinker availability.

significance.rationale: L1 open-weight looped transformer release with independent Artificial Analysis verification, pending follow-on works or unaffiliated production deployments.
significance.whyNotHigher: Under L2-METHOD and L2-PRODUCT-ACCESS, independent_follow_on_works >= 2 and unaffiliated_production_organizations >= 2 are null as of Nov 26.
significance.whyNotLower: Verified primary open-weight release plus independent Artificial Analysis compute-efficiency verification.

new_method_or_framework.rationale: Ships one of the first open-weight looped MoE models with native NVFP4/MXFP8 deployment and variable-loop research checkpoint.

independent_follow_on_works.rationale: Only 6 days post-release; >= 2 independent follow-on research works are not yet documented.

impactBasis.baseline: Prior Inkling 2 Small release (Nov 5) deferred open weights and restricted access to Tinker.
impactBasis.outcome: Inkling 2 Mini shipped immediately with downloadable open weights on Hugging Face and independent Artificial Analysis efficiency verification.

consensus.reason: Open-weight availability and Artificial Analysis efficiency measurement are verified; long-term adoption is still accumulating.

dispute.reason: No factual dispute; Artificial Analysis explicitly noted the tradeoff of ~38% more output tokens for ~2.8x lower compute proxy.

evidence.quote: Inkling 2 Mini is a Mixture-of-Experts model with 26.4B total parameters, 3.4B active, and 5.4B weight activations per token to account for looping.
Inkling 2 Mini is released with open weights and is available on Tinker today for inference and customization.
The weights are available for download through Hugging Face here.
Inkling 2 Mini uses ~38% more output tokens than Qwen3.8 27B for the same Intelligence Index score, but ~2.8x less compute.
